field.name: DispositionSummary
field.schemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="DispositionSummary" StaticName="DispositionSummary" DisplayName="Disposition summary" Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"><Default></Default></Field>

validationMessage: For any state beyond Received, enter a disposition summary. Incorporated also requires the document version in which the change was incorporated. Suggestions and recorded dispositions do not authorise a policy.
history: Version history preserves prior summaries; append-only Decision rationale retains detailed discussion. Existing records are not backfilled.
